name: Luxia
source: The ‘chibi’ of the group. Her life is the testimony to what Arin may have become if his clan wasn’t slaughtered. She has an indifferent nature to life and keeps everyone at a distance. This is due to the fact that among Praecantator, she was born with near limitless life energy and had total control over radiation. She was also a treated as a child prodigy and had to suffer growing up carrying the hopes of her race.
